item.title: Minna Daisuki Kozukuri Banchou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Anastasia
  • 発売日: 2007-05-18
  • スコア: 6.540000000000001/10 (881 人評価)
  • 日本語名: みんな大好き子づくりばんちょう
  • 英語名: Minna Daisuki Kozukuri Banchou

あらすじ

To counter the declining number of childbirths, government decides to activate a plan. All schools across the country will enter contests against each other. The losing school will be shut down and its students will enter the service of the winners. Thus re-igniting the spirits of the lost young generation and hopefully producing healthy couples capable of childbirth again.

item.title: Mahou ga Sekai o Sukuimasu!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Anastasia
  • 発売日: 2006-05-26
  • スコア: 6.1/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔法が世界を救います！
  • 英語名: Mahou ga Sekai o Sukuimasu!

あらすじ

From the shadows “magicians” protect the order of the world.

Several years ago in a place known to noone the protagonist (named Kreutz) has lost his powers in a battle where the stake has been the world itself. Now, according to his master’s will, he arrived in town to protect his daughters. Due to unexpected events Kreutz ended up teaching magic to Flora, one of the daughters, to make her a full-fledged magician.
